title: Segfault caused by a cheap USB controller (Esperanza EG102)
body:
### Tested versions

I have reproduced this in a few recent beta builds I tested (IIRC beta 7 and beta 5).

### System information

Windows 10, Ryzen 3900X, AMD RX 6800 XT

### Issue description

```
unfa@DESKTOP-OQ6LBOV MINGW64 ~/Downloads/Godot_v4.5-beta7_win64.exe
$ ./Godot_v4.5-beta7_win64 --verbose
WorkerThreadPool: 24 threads, 7 max low-priority.
Godot Engine v4.5.beta7.official.4ebf67c12 - https://godotengine.org
TextServer: Added interface "Dummy"
TextServer: Added interface "ICU / HarfBuzz / Graphite (Built-in)"
Unrecognized output string "misc2" in mapping:
030000000d0f00000202000000000000,Horipad O Nintendo Switch 2 Controller,a:b1,b:b0,back:b8,dpdown:h0.4,dpleft:h0.8,dpright:h0.2,dpup:h0.1,guide:b12,leftshoulder:b4,leftstick:b10,lefttrigger:b6,leftx:a0,lefty:a1,misc1:b13,misc2:b14,rightshoulder:b5,rightst
Unrecognized output string "misc2" in mapping:
030000000d0f00009601000000000000,Horipad Steam,a:b0,b:b1,back:b10,dpdown:h0.4,dpleft:h0.8,dpright:h0.2,dpup:h0.1,guide:b12,leftshoulder:b6,leftstick:b13,lefttrigger:b8,leftx:a0,lefty:a1,misc2:b2,paddle1:b5,paddle2:b15,paddle3:b18,paddle4:b19,rightshoulde
Unrecognized output string "misc2" in mapping:
030000007e0500006920000000000000,Nintendo Switch 2 Pro Controller,a:b0,b:b1,back:b14,dpdown:b8,dpleft:b10,dpright:b9,dpup:b11,guide:b16,leftshoulder:b12,leftstick:b15,lefttrigger:b13,leftx:a0,lefty:a1~,misc1:b17,misc2:b20,paddle1:b18,paddle2:b19,rightsho
Native OpenGL API detected: 3.3: ATI Technologies Inc. - AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
Segmentation fault
```

Arch Linux on the exact same machine runs the editor no problem.

After disconnecting a cheap USB game pad (Esperanza EG102) the engine starts fine.

That same controller does not cause crashes in Godot 4.4.1 stable.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Connect Esperanza EG102 over USB
2. Run Godot 4.5 - segfault
3. Disconnect controller
4. Godot 4.5 runs fine

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

No need for any project - just running the Godot editor's project manager fails.
